editorial.blurb: An unassuming parking lot gem serving unforgettable al pastor tacos with perfectly crispy-yet-pillowy tortillas and salsas that pack serious flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or expect a wait—this spot draws lines consistently, but the staff will keep you happy with samples of their agua fresca while you hold down a patio table.

topDishes.note: reviewers call them magic—moist, flavorful, with the signature crispy-yet-soft tortillas
